header: Change the agent’s identity and role
content:
７ Note
Changing the Phishing Triage Agent’s identity is only available to users with the Security
Administrator role.
Pausing the agent temporarily stops all triage activity, including any in-progress triage tasks.
The agent doesn’t process new incidents until it’s resumed. Resuming the agent resumes all its
activities, allowing it to start triaging and classifying incoming alerts again.
To pause or resume the agent:
1. Navigate to the Overview page under Agents in Defender portal.
